# One case per line: R (refuse) or A (allow), a space, then the Bash command.
# <NL> stands for a newline inside the command.
R git push --force origin 42-x
R git push -f
R git push -uf origin 42-x
R git push --force-with-lease origin 42-x
R git push --mirror origin
R git push origin +42-x
R git reset --hard origin/main
R cd /tmp/x && git -C repo reset --hard
R git status; git clean -fd
R git clean -f -x
R git checkout -- .
R git checkout .
R git restore .
R git restore --worktree --staged .
R echo $(git reset --hard)
R bash -c 'cd x && git reset --hard'
R sh -c "git push -f"
R eval "git clean -fdx"
R git -c alias.zz='!git reset --hard' zz
R git -c user.name=x commit -m msg
R git --config-env=alias.zz=E zz
R GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=alias.zz git zz
R export GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="'alias.zz=!x'"
R env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/tmp/evil git status
R git config --global user.name x
R git commit -F - <<'EOF'<NL>message<NL>EOF<NL>git reset --hard
R git status 2>&1 | head; git push --force
A git push origin 42-x
A git push -u origin 42-x
A git push origin main
A git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
A git reset --soft HEAD~1
A git reset HEAD -- file.txt
A git clean -n -fd
A git clean -x
A git checkout -- src/a.sh
A git checkout 42-x
A git restore --staged .
A git restore src/a.sh
A git stash
A git branch -D old
A git switch -c 42-x
A git merge --no-ff 42-x
A git config user.email a@b.c
A git config --get user.name
A git commit -m "never git reset --hard"
A git commit -F - <<'EOF'<NL>do not git push --force<NL>EOF<NL>git status
A gh pr create --body "git push -f is refused"
A echo GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
A git log --oneline -5 # then git reset --hard
A ls -la
A git push origin 42-x 2>&1 | tail -3
